name: Project Intelligence
description: Understand projects, people, suppliers, subcontractors and the context that connects them.

features.name: Project Context
features.description: Understand the project, scope, client, site, status and key constraints before recommending or automating work.
features.controls: Use verified project records and flag missing or conflicting information.

features.name: Company & Project Knowledge
features.description: Retrieve relevant information from approved project documents, company procedures, contracts and records.
features.controls: Keep sources current and preserve project and company boundaries.

features.name: Project Memory
features.description: Retain relevant decisions, constraints, commitments and unresolved items across the life of a project.
features.controls: Save useful facts with provenance rather than indiscriminate transcripts.

features.name: Project Relationships
features.description: Connect clients, suppliers, subcontractors and team members to the projects and responsibilities they belong to.
features.controls: Confirm identity and project association before joining information.

features.name: Context Management
features.description: Review, correct and remove saved project context so the intelligence layer stays accurate.
features.controls: Keep corrections traceable and respect retention requirements.

name: Communication Intelligence
description: Understand construction email, messages and correspondence and route each item into the right project workflow.

features.name: Email & Message Intake
features.description: Capture authorised project communication and identify the project, sender, document and request involved.
features.controls: Verify mailbox access, project match and permitted data scope.

features.name: Construction Correspondence
features.description: Interpret requests, questions and changes using the relevant project history and construction context.
features.controls: Escalate ambiguity and never invent project facts.

features.name: Client & Trade Updates
features.description: Prepare accurate project updates for clients, subcontractors and suppliers using verified information.
features.controls: Human approval can be required before external delivery.

features.name: RFI & RFQ Intelligence
features.description: Recognise information and quotation requests, gather relevant context and prepare the next step.
features.controls: Keep contractual and commercial approvals explicit.

features.name: Human Handover
features.description: Escalate uncertain, sensitive or high-value matters to the right person with relevant context attached.
features.controls: Automation remains paused until an authorised person continues it.

name: Workflow Automation
description: Turn incoming construction information into controlled, repeatable work across the systems the company already uses.

features.name: Workflow Orchestration
features.description: Coordinate triggers, checks, approvals, actions and exceptions across construction workflows.
features.controls: Apply approvals, duplicate protection and exception handling.

features.name: Email-to-Action Automation
features.description: Turn relevant inbox traffic into project tasks, drafts, reviews and follow-ups instead of manual re-entry.
features.controls: Sending and external writes remain permission-controlled.

features.name: Scheduling & Follow-Ups
features.description: Coordinate project reminders, commitments, follow-ups and assigned actions from verified project events.
features.controls: Check dates, owners and dependencies before committing changes.

features.name: Document & Data Automation
features.description: Read construction documents, extract structured fields and route them into the correct project process.
features.controls: Flag uncertain fields for human review.

features.name: Automated Project Briefings
features.description: Assemble concise project and company briefings from current priorities, changes, risks and unresolved work.
features.controls: Show source freshness and distinguish unknowns from zeroes.

name: Commercial & Cost Intelligence
description: Use project, quote, invoice and material information to surface commercial changes and potential cost issues earlier.

features.name: Estimating & Quote Context
features.description: Bring scope, allowances, pricing and project context together to support faster estimating and quoting workflows.
features.controls: Do not invent quantities, rates or contractual assumptions.

features.name: Automated Quote Follow-Up
features.description: Track eligible proposals and prepare follow-ups when agreed timing and stopping rules are met.
features.controls: Stop on reply, decision, opt-out or human takeover.

features.name: Cost & Margin Intelligence
features.description: Compare estimates, commitments, purchases and progress to surface potential margin pressure and missing information.
features.controls: Forecasts are decision support, not guaranteed final outcomes.

features.name: Variation Intelligence
features.description: Identify potential scope changes, collect supporting context and prepare a controlled variation review workflow.
features.controls: Require appropriate contractual and commercial approval before issue.

features.name: Material Usage Intelligence
features.description: Compare estimated quantities with purchased or delivered quantities and project progress to surface unusual consumption.
features.controls: Validate units, invoice interpretation and physical progress before relying on a forecast.

name: Construction Integrations
description: Connect Construct to the construction, accounting and communication systems a business already uses.

features.name: Construction Workspace
features.description: Bring project, contact, document, activity and AI workflow context into one management workspace.
features.controls: Keep tenant, project and role boundaries explicit.

features.name: Procore Integration
features.description: Connect approved Procore project data and workflows where the customer plan, API access and permissions support it.
features.controls: Required endpoints and write permissions are verified during implementation.

features.name: Xero Integration
features.description: Connect approved accounting data and draft workflows while preserving human approval for financial writes where required.
features.controls: Approval, duplicate protection and accounting scope must be configured.

features.name: Microsoft 365 Integration
features.description: Use authorised Outlook and Microsoft 365 information as inputs to project communication and workflow automation.
features.controls: Mailbox, tenant and permission scope are verified before use.

features.name: Other Construction Systems
features.description: Connect supported construction software through available APIs, webhooks and approved integration methods.
features.controls: Integration feasibility is checked rather than assumed.

name: Approvals & Control
description: Keep people in control of sensitive construction decisions with permissions, approvals, audit history and clear data boundaries.

features.name: Company Workspaces
features.description: Separate each construction company into its own secure workspace and data boundary.
features.controls: Isolation must be enforced at the data layer as well as the interface.

features.name: Roles & Permissions
features.description: Define what owners, admins, managers, members and viewers may see or change.
features.controls: Sensitive actions require the appropriate role.

features.name: Project Data Boundaries
features.description: Keep project, company and customer information within the correct authorised context.
features.controls: Never use another company’s data to fill a gap.

features.name: Human Approvals & Audit
features.description: Require review for selected actions and maintain a traceable record of what the system proposed and what people approved.
features.controls: Separate proposed, approved and completed work.

features.name: Document & Data Lifecycle
features.description: Define retention, export and deletion arrangements for project documents and saved context.
features.controls: Include backups and provider retention in the implementation design.

features.name: AI Processing Controls
features.description: Define what project information AI providers may process and what must remain excluded or redacted.
features.controls: Provider, retention and processing requirements are implementation decisions.
